description_en: Super Apartment for sale 3+1+2 Zogu Boulevard 1 Super Apartment for sale 3+1+2 214 m/2 on the 5th floor of a 12-story building with a clear view from the boulevard. The apartment is organized in an entrance, a large corridor with distribution on the right, living room, front kitchen, distribution corridor where the bedrooms come, one with a personal toilet, wardrobe, storage room, 2 large balconies, fully furnished. The apartment has a total area of 214m/2 where 2 apartments with separate certificates are joined, the apartments are joined in 1, where in in case of separation, they are very accessible. The building is located at the front of the 1st boulevard, on the edge of the boulevard, it has 2 large elevators, the entrance is on the main road. The area where the apartment is located is an elite central area, with all the facilities for a comfortable life. For more information, contact me.
